workflow:
name: ci-quality-gates-incremental

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # releases-check compares the register with main's history

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          version: "0.10.0"
          python-version: "3.13.7"

      - name: Install Python
        run: uv python install

      - name: Install orchestrator dev dependencies
        run: |
          env -u AGENT uv sync --project orchestrator --all-extras --frozen --python 3.13.7

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Install locked formatter
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts

      - name: Run repository CI gate
        run: env -u AGENT uv run --project orchestrator --extra dev python scripts/checks/run-repository-gate.py ci

      - name: Retain report
        if: always()
        run: echo retain
hook:
repos:
  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: repository-gate
        name: Repository commit gate (check only)
        entry: env -u AGENT uv run --project orchestrator --extra dev python scripts/checks/run-repository-gate.py commit
        language: system
        pass_filenames: false
        always_run: true
        stages: [pre-commit]
